text: New on the App Store: Colorful, a quiet coloring book for young children. Tap a shape and it fills with color. Eleven worlds, eighty-eight pictures, no ads, no accounts and no chat. For ages three and up.
Staring at a blank page? Tap once and Drawing Pad gives you something to draw. Today's idea: a cat on the moon. Then sketch it right in the app, on a clean canvas that stays out of your way.
Learning the alphabet should feel like play. In ABC Learning, every picture card says its word out loud.
Today's idea: draw a cat on the moon. Not sure where to start? Drawing Pad shows the steps, and you draw it your way.
Space, Sea World, Bugs, Toys, Sports and more. Colorful has eleven worlds and eighty-eight pictures to color.
Letters, numbers, shapes, colors and first words. ABC Learning teaches them by seeing and hearing together.
Pens, pencils and paint brushes, with undo and redo so you can try things. Drawing Pad keeps the tools simple.
In Colorful, each crayon color is said out loud, so children learn the names while they color.
No ads and nothing to click away from. ABC Learning is a calm place for early learners.
Draw on a blank page, or on top of your own photos. Drawing Pad works both ways.
Spots, stripes, stars and hearts. Colorful has patterns as well as plain crayon colors.
One topic at a time, so it never feels like too much. ABC Learning has 22 packs in 6 groups.
Add stickers to your drawing. Drawing Pad has over 2000 of them. Then save it in HD and share it.
Made a mistake while coloring? One tap and it is undone. Colorful is made for little hands.
A quick tour on the first day shows grown-ups and children how ABC Learning works together.
Pick a category for your next idea: animals, nature, fantasy or space. Drawing Pad has eight in all.
Every Colorful picture saves itself. Send the finished ones to Photos, to a printer, or to someone who would love to see them.
ABC Learning works without internet once a pack is saved, so it is ready for the car or the waiting room.
The Continue Drawing widget shows your latest drawing on the Home Screen, so you can jump back in with one tap.
The Picture of the Day widget puts a new page to color on your Home Screen. Tap it and the page opens, ready to color.
The Word of the Day widget brings a new word to your Home Screen. A small daily habit for little learners.
No ads while you draw. Drawing Pad is a calm place to doodle, with just you and the page.
No ads, no accounts and no chat. Colorful is something you can hand over and take a breath.
The quiz at the end of each topic is gentle: no scores and no pressure.
Want more? Premium removes the daily limits on drawings and ideas in Drawing Pad.
Colorful comes in 19 languages, with the color names spoken in each. For ages three and up.
Settings in ABC Learning sit behind a short question only adults can answer.
A daily doodle is a good way to unwind. Open Drawing Pad, tap for an idea, and draw for five minutes.
Colorful works without internet after the first launch, when it downloads the pages once.
No ads and no tracking in ABC Learning. Just picture cards that talk.
